hooks.command: p="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; y="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; if [ -n "$p" ] && [ -n "$y" ] && [ -f "$p/hooks/recallum_hook.py" ]; then exec "$y" "$p/hooks/recallum_hook.py" session; fi; cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; $p = Get-Command python3, python, py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $s = if ($r) { Join-Path $r 'hooks/recallum_hook.py' }; if ($p -and $s -and (Test-Path $s)) { & $p.Source $s session } else { $null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); exit 0 }"
